title: Nonempty-open unit for a normal constant sheaf
statement: Let Y be an integral scheme whose local rings are integrally closed, let j : U ⟶ Y be a nonempty open immersion, and let M be a module over a commutative ring Λ. The unit from the constant Λ-module sheaf on Y to its pushforward along j is an isomorphism.

proof.text: The generic point of an integral scheme belongs to every nonempty open. The range of the map from its local spectrum consists of points generalizing the generic point, hence only the generic point. It is contained in the range of j, so IsOpenImmersion.lift gives a factorization h = g ≫ j.
Apply the generic-point unit isomorphism to the constant sheaf F, obtaining F ≅ h_*h^*F. The direct-image composition isomorphism lowerStarComp identifies the latter with j_*g_*h^*F.

Direct image along an open immersion is fully faithful. Mathlib CategoryTheory.Adjunction.isIso_unit_app_of_iso therefore shows that the unit at F is an isomorphism, since the preceding isomorphism exhibits F in the essential image of j_*.

proof_origin.document: Stacks Project, Tag 09Z5; generic-point unit and categorical essential-image argument
proof_origin.place: Nonempty-open conjunct: factor the generic local-spectrum map through the open, use lowerStarComp, then Mathlib CategoryTheory.Adjunction.isIso_unit_app_of_iso.
